body:
New EMILY/continuity/google-oauth-runbook.md: a running, git-iterated instruction file naming the single next concrete step to get Google OAuth working, per the founder's own requested process (one step at a time, founder attempts it, gives feedback if blocked, file gets updated, repeat). Step 1: create the OAuth consent screen + a real OAuth 2.0 Web application Client ID in Google Cloud Console, with the exact Authorized JavaScript origins/redirect URIs both real IDUNA code paths (GoogleAuthHandler's GIS button flow, WebCeremonyHandler's own server-side flow) actually need. Real lead used: an earlier continuity note already confirmed iduna.farthq.com live via curl, used as the best-guess domain for the founder to confirm/correct. commit 6593f443.

⚓ ☃
title: Google OAuth runbook -- Step 1 (GCP Console OAuth client)
